svg.title: Figure 10 · Monte Carlo estimation error
svg.desc: 99% risk of standard normal losses. Each sample size uses 300 independent synthetic replications, NumPy seed 4106. RMSE includes finite-sample bias; the dashed line shows a rate reference, not a fitted guarantee.
